product.description: Blackbird™ by Monoprice™8K60 2x2 HDMI Matrix With Audio Extraction, HDMI 2.1, HDCP 2.3Connect two 8K60 sources to two 8K60 monitors and send content from either source to either or both monitors.The 44438 Blackbird 8K60 2x2 HDMI Matrix can mix content from two HDMI inputs between two HDMI outputs. It can send content from either of the HDMI inputs to either of both outputs simultaneously. It supports video resolution up to 8K60 4:2:0. The device also features advanced EDID management and audio extraction.
